title: US Official Announces Trilateral Talks with Ukraine and Russia in Abu Dhabi
detail: A US official announced that trilateral talks between the United States, Ukraine and Russia will be held in Abu Dhabi next week. Agenda, delegation levels and exact dates were not available in the aggregated summary.

title: Zelensky Confirms Ukraine Targeted Russian Emergency Alert Systems in Retaliatory Hack
detail: Zelensky confirmed that Ukraine targeted Russian emergency alert systems in a retaliatory hack. Details on scope, timing and impact were not available in the aggregated summary.
